# Additional hidden-style packages

- `codex-aster-quay/`: table-heavy specification; unusual business week, MDY security, three deadline kinds, notes off and zero retries.
- `codex-bracken-thread/`: newest-first signed email thread; five override groups, reversed interim rules, four security questions, business month-end, notes on and renamed API fields.

These are invented bank documents with seven-operation OpenAPI contracts and independently authored expected-value oracles. Feed only each package's numbered documents plus its OpenAPI to future extraction. Expected JSON, date probes and READMEs are evaluation material, not builder input. No public mock customer records apply to these banks.

The companion live public-customer fixtures are in `../edge/codex-1.json` and `../edge/codex-2.json` (15 cases); see that folder's README for coverage and ambiguity decisions. All work here is offline; no extraction, build, simulation or Freya API calls were made.
